items.summary: Fix the Web Audio API sound system in `frontend/src/hooks/useTetrisAudio.ts` so that all sound effects (piece placement, line clear, level up, game over) and background music play correctly. Specifically: (1) defer AudioContext creation until the first user interaction (click/touch/keypress) to comply with browser autoplay policy; (2) resume a suspended AudioContext on each user interaction before playing any sound; (3) ensure the mute toggle correctly suspends/resumes both music and effects without destroying the AudioContext; (4) guarantee that background music loops without interruption once started; (5) fix any broken references so that the audio hook's play functions are correctly wired into the game loop in `useGameLogic.ts` and triggered on the appropriate game events.
